instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Corporate law firm with 45 lawyers specializing in M&A, tax structuring, competition law, and cross-border transactions. Serving 200+ corporate clients across technology, financial services, and energy sectors. They focus on leveraging AI-assisted contract review to streamline due diligence processes for complex legal documentation.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: We have a new CEO who joined 3 months ago from a more digitally mature industry. She has signaled that innovation and digital transformation will be top strategic priorities, replacing the previous leadership's conservative, cost-cutting orientation. The organization is cautiously optimistic but also uncertain about what concrete changes to expect.
answers.teamSize: We have a corporate innovation division with 50+ staff spanning research scientists, engineers, designers, and strategy professionals. The division manages a portfolio of 15 active innovation projects at various maturity stages, from early-stage research collaborations with universities to near-commercialization products. Annual innovation budget is managed through a formal portfolio governance process with stage-gate funding decisions.

opportunities.title: Automated Workflow Integration Suite
opportunities.rationale: Develop and deploy a low-cost module that seamlessly integrates the existing AI contract review tool with common internal firm workflows (e.g., client intake, billing), dramatically increasing adoption among current legal teams.

first_actions: Select 3 high-value internal workflow bottlenecks for initial automation mapping
Allocate $150k from the innovation budget for rapid MVP development (6 weeks)
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 70% adoption rate among targeted legal teams within Q3

opportunities.title: Legal Tech as a Service (LaaS) Framework
opportunities.rationale: Position the core AI capabilities not just as an internal tool, but as a scalable API offering for smaller competitors or mid-market firms, creating a new recurring revenue stream.

first_actions: Conduct market sizing survey on SaaS adoption rates in specialized legal tech niches
Draft whitepaper defining the 'LaaS' product roadmap and pricing tiers
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 2 pilot SaaS contracts with mid-sized firms within the year
milestones: Market validation and pricing model finalized (Month 3)
Initial sales pipeline established for LaaS offering (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Conduct a formal strategy workshop focused exclusively on market diversification scenarios (new service lines or adjacent tech partnerships).
Establish cross-functional 'Tiger Teams' for the Radical SaaS framework, securing initial talent allocation and seed funding.

key_weaknesses: Organizational Inertia: Slow cross-departmental alignment prevents rapid scaling of new tech initiatives.
Talent Gap: Lack of specialized 'Legal Tech Monetization' expertise needed to transition internal tools into viable SaaS models.
Strategy Drift: Short time horizon for diversification risks prioritizing incremental optimization over bold market entry.
